review: Drafted 2026-09-27 from the scope notes of the Odoo Skills and the owner's default that an unqualified 订单 includes quotations. The owner decided 产品 on 2026-09-27; the other entries await the owner's review. Meanings are written in the goal index's own terms.

conventions.meaning: sale.order (Sales Order) in every Status, quotations included; narrowed only when the request itself says so (报价 for quotations, 销售订单, 已确认 or 成交 for confirmed orders)
sale.order with Status = Sales Order (confirmed orders); quotations are not included
sale.order with Status in Quotation, Quotation Sent (not yet confirmed)
account.move with Type = Customer Invoice, credit notes not included; when the request says 供应商 or 账单 it means Type = Vendor Bill instead
account.move with Type = Customer Credit Note
product.template, every product whether or not it can be sold or purchased (the Sales = Yes scope of the Products page does not apply unless the request says so)
